title: es + adjective + que with past mood, era, avoiding the mood tense with lo + adjective + es que

cards.title: Present main verb, past event
cards.body: After a present 'it's not relevant that…', you can refer back to the past with the past mood tense, or use the present mood tense.

examples.en: It's not very relevant that they found it.
examples.es: No es muy relevante que lo encontraran.

examples.en: It's not very relevant that they find it.
examples.es: No es muy relevante que lo encuentren.

examples.en: It was very relevant that they found it.
examples.es: Era muy relevante que lo encontraran.

cards.title: Shortcut: lo + adjective + es que
cards.body: In a fast conversation, sidestep the mood tense: 'the important thing is that…' (lo importante es que) takes the normal tense. Increíble = 'un-believe-able' (creer = to believe).

examples.en: It's incredible that they come back.
The incredible thing is that they come back.
The incredible thing is that they do it again.
examples.es: Lo increíble es que vuelven a hacerlo.

examples.en: It's incredible that they do it again.
examples.es: Es increíble que vuelvan a hacerlo.

examples.en: It's incredible that they did it again.
examples.es: Es increíble que volvieran a hacerlo.
